method: Audited the exact eleven load-bearing surfaces scored by check-completeness.py rather than searching for the word status globally.
Found that operability.v2 already supplied the required closed SPECIFIED, IMPLEMENTABLE, QUALIFIED, DEMONSTRATED, BLOCKED-NO-MECHANISM, PARTIAL machine and retained-evidence transitions.

Classified every surface explicitly: four live legacy property tables, canonical OPERABILITY gates, canonical DELIVERY properties, derived TM publication, three surfaces with no architecture-assurance table, and EVIDENCE's orthogonal per-Run custody vocabulary.

Reproduced the Reviewer-2 defect on C-2 and VERSIONING: an implementable:true test could support DISCHARGED with no retained execution. Downgraded every such live row to SPECIFIED / IMPLEMENTABLE_UNEXECUTED and strengthened both local mutation suites.

Bound the cross-surface adapter and ran mutations that attempt implementable-only discharge on C-2, FACT-IDENTITY, VERSIONING, and R-1; bare qualification/demonstration; editorial release; threat publication; hidden assurance tables; and denominator/state-machine drift.

findingDispositions.evidence: FACT-IDENTITY, DELIVERY, and R-1 had already been narrowed after Reviewer-2; the convergence audit found the same latent defect still live in C-2 and VERSIONING. artifacts/assurance-state.v1.json now binds the existing OPERABILITY machine across the exact 11-surface denominator. check-assurance.py rejects implementable:true to DISCHARGED/DEMONSTRATED without retained evidence identities, while C-2 and VERSIONING local checkers carry the same negative control.
findingDispositions.reasoning: Feasibility, gate-harness qualification, release demonstration, and Run evidence custody are different predicates. One canonical machine plus explicit adapters preserves current domain vocabularies without letting any boolean test declaration perform an evidentiary transition.
findingDispositions.requiredChange: Register assurance-state.v1 and this adjudication as the R2-FINAL-02 cross-cutting authority; retain check-assurance.py and its selftest in the freeze verification command; remove only R2-FINAL-02 from crossCuttingSealBlockers.
findingDispositions.verification: check-assurance.py covers 11/11 adapters and its 12-mutation selftest rejects four implementable-only discharge attempts, weak evidence promotions, false release/publication, hidden state, and denominator drift. check-c2.py and check-versioning.py normal runs and their expanded mutation suites pass.
findingDispositions.whatWouldChangeMyMind: A live assurance-bearing surface outside the exact completeness denominator, or a consumer that can interpret a lower state/test boolean as product evidence despite the binding adapter and release derivation.

DISCHARGED is permitted only as a DEMONSTRATED compatibility spelling with retained evidence identities
design-integrity checkers cannot discharge product properties
release and threat publication remain derived from retained DEMONSTRATED release evidence
Run evidence custody capabilities are orthogonal to product assurance
knownLimitations: No product exists; this adjudication demonstrates design consistency, not any product property.
The checker can require evidence identities and correct derivation but cannot inspect a future evidence store before implementation exists.
New architecture surfaces or assurance-bearing fields require an explicit adapter; AS-8 makes omission a checker failure.
R2-FINAL-03 and all surface-specific residuals are outside this adjudication.

sealRecommendation.note: R2-FINAL-02 is closed when the coordinator registers this policy/adjudication and the cross checker is green. Product release remains NOT-DEMONSTRATED.
sealRecommendation.consumerB: Treat SPECIFIED and IMPLEMENTABLE as build obligations only. Accept no product or publication claim below retained DEMONSTRATED evidence for the identified release.
